pages.title: Glowing
pages.text:
$(l)double$() level, $(l)Entity$() target, $(l)double$() duration -> Glowing -> $(l)Entity$() target
This rune sequence is order-sensitive

Applies Glowing effect to the entity.
Mana cost: duration * (level + 1)^2

Enemies under the Glowing effect remain visible even when blocked by obstacles.
